scope: First reasoned static review of the three supplied samples. No specimen executed. No deployment circumstances or provenance beyond the supplied files were assumed.

tofsee.judgement: Concrete concealed Defender exclusion, Run-key registration, PE image transplant and token-based UAC bypass outweigh benign uses of SMTP or process APIs. An explicit runas fallback exists; it does not explain away the separate token bypass, concealed exclusions or covert image transfer.
tofsee.decoder: 0x402544: copies source XOR key; initial key E4; key increments by C8 plus alternating +1/-1. Call arguments and actual input addresses were recovered, not inferred from family traits.
existing_coverage_verified: 0x4083c0-0x40844a: decode SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Exclusions\Paths, open HKLM and write zero REG_DWORD for the chosen directory.

0x40977c-0x409866: CreateProcessA CREATE_SUSPENDED; GetThreadContext; copy native image through 0x40637c; write PEB.ImageBaseAddress at saved EBX+8; set saved EAX to replacement entry; SetThreadContext; ResumeThread.

0x40a7c1: SMTP command-state switch constructs EHLO/HELO, AUTH LOGIN, MAIL FROM, RCPT TO, DATA, QUIT; formats messages and invokes Winsock send/recv through actual imported pointers. Template replacement uses FROM/TO macros and delivery counters. Existing Tofsee identities and SMTP template traits preserved.
new_coverage: 0x409f11-0x409f64: decoder input 0x4106ac is the 46-byte Windows CurrentVersion Run key; RegOpenKeyExA HKCU with write access; same HKEY stack slot reaches RegSetValueExA with REG_SZ data.

0x409145-0x4091eb: GetModuleFileNameA path converted with CharToOemA and supplied twice to decoded batch template at 0x4107a8; 0x409064 creates/writes temporary .bat, then ShellExecuteA launches it hidden. Template retries deleting own image, delays via loopback ping, and deletes %%0.

0x401280-0x4017xx: launches wusa.exe requesting process handle; resolves NtOpenProcessToken and NtDuplicateToken; sets TokenIntegrityLevel=25 to medium SID RID 0x2000; NtFilterToken LUA_TOKEN=4; duplicate impersonation token; NtSetInformationThread class 5; CreateProcessWithLogonW LOGON_NETCREDENTIALS_ONLY=2. Source at 0x409326 passes its generated command text into this helper.

0x409326: decoded source 0x410918 supplies mkdir/move/sc create binPath/type own/start auto/sc start script to wsprintfA, later passed via wide conversion to execution helper. Required command fragments wildcard chosen display/description strings.

0x40946c-0x40949b: decoded source 0x410888 supplies netsh advfirewall add rule, dir=in action=allow program placeholder enable=yes to wsprintfA. Chosen rule name is wildcarded; neutral notable capability retained separately from intent.

tofsee.limits: No runtime success was claimed. Configured final tasking endpoints and live deployment were not established.

injector.judgement: StormAttack-derived loader code supports covert persistence, DLL injection and cleanup; file naming alone does not establish Elex or WannaCry. No file-encryption or ransom behavior is evidenced in the surviving code.
paths: CRT entry 0x402674 calls 0x401cb0; configuration DWORD 0x404120=3 selects 0x401900 Active Setup branch then self-cleanup at 0x401390.
0x401900 writes HKLM Active Setup Installed Components\<generated id> StubPath with REG_EXPAND_SZ, reads own executable with CRT I/O, patches configuration and writes/relaunches a copy.
0x401150 creates a child, allocates remote memory, writes DLL path, resolves LoadLibraryA and passes that actual export as CreateRemoteThread start with remote path argument.
0x401260 deletes and replaces LanmanServer Parameters ServiceDLL; 0x402460 extracts resource id101 DLL through Find/Size/Load/LockResource, then writes it via 0x4023c0.

0x401fd0 copies own executable; at 0x402178 sets Hidden|System mask 6 on the same installation path; creates auto-start own-process service at 0x4021de and starts it. This supports the new attribute-concealment composite.
0x401390 builds COMSPEC /c del using GetModuleFileNameA and GetShortPathNameA; appended .htext begins with a call back to this cleanup routine and filler.
injector.limits: Entire .rsrc raw span 0x5000..0xf000 is zero; only MZ is the outer header. No recoverable embedded DLL or archive member. Resource-based payload success and any final DDoS/ransom capability cannot be claimed. Static surviving attack code still supports the malicious verdict.

php.judgement: The complete 136-byte PHP source exposes two unauthenticated cookie-controlled execution surfaces without validation: system($_COOKIE[command]) and eval($_COOKIE[code]). On a server this is an arbitrary command/code backdoor. Source provenance and deployment authorization were not supplied.
paths: isset guard at line2 -> system on line3
independent isset guard at line5 -> eval on line6
php.coverage_goal: Two hostile behaviors are supported, both covered. Complete-source inspection found no staging, persistence, evasion, cleanup, theft or other distinct behavior to justify a third hostile trait. The new AST matcher binds the entire raw request argument; predicate, constant-eval and quoted-source controls remain negative. PHP flow projection lacks sink call provenance, so parsed structural matching is used instead.

placement.run: Concealed durable HKCU Run registration belongs under persistence/login/registry/autostart; it binds decoded key, actual write API and shared HKEY. The hostile composite additionally requires image transplantation. No plain registry-write API or key-name reference was placed in objectives.
placement.service_and_firewall: Formatting concrete encoded service/firewall commands is notable capability evidence under os/service/create and os/firewall/netsh. UAC/token abuse supplies the service persistence composite admission.
placement.php: Direct request evaluation is a webshell request/eval surface; process execution remains separately covered under request/command.
placement.hidden: Hidden/System attributes stay notable in the existing neutral atom; resource injection plus bound persistence supplies concealment intent. No family/chosen payload name gates the new hostile rule.

verification.shared_rule_weakening: None; all changes add supported coverage. Every original finding is retained.
verification.classifier: All three remain HOSTILE; no verdict disagreement. The installed model warns that its feature schema is v18, while engine supports v21.
verification.validation: Run make validate as the final action; its terminal result is authoritative.

engine_boundary: Both PE files emit metadata/encoded-payload/url because the extractor mechanically URL-decodes printf formats: Tofsee MIME boundary ----=_NextPart_%03d_%04X_%08.8lX.%08.8lX and StormAttack GUID {%08X-%04X-...}. These are ordinary format templates, not concealed URLs or network-contact evidence. This built-in extraction observation has no YAML owner or dependent consumer here. No YAML shadow or sample exception was added.
